headline: London protesters demand limits on advanced artificial intelligence over human extinction risks
label: VIRAL
caption:
Activists took to the streets in London to demand strict limits on advanced artificial intelligence.

According to Anadolu Agency and Yeni Safak English, protesters warned about the severe risk of human extinction due to rapidly developing technology.

Demonstrators called on authorities to pause the development of advanced artificial intelligence systems until proper safety measures are put in place.

Public concern continues to grow as experts and activists debate the long term dangers of unregulated artificial intelligence.
